structured_output_validity.definition: LLM attempts whose reply validated against RCAOutput / LLM attempts (provider errors excluded)

category_accuracy.definition: final category == labelled category / cases labelled conclusive

evidence_grounding_accuracy.definition: 'observed' quotes found verbatim in their cited source / all 'observed' quotes (final analyses)

unsupported_claim_rate.definition: (unverifiable 'observed' quotes + affected files absent from trace/retrieved file) / (all quotes + all affected files)

abstention_recall.definition: inconclusive-labelled cases where the model declared insufficient evidence or category 'unknown' / inconclusive-labelled cases

inconclusive_not_accepted_rate.definition: inconclusive-labelled cases the quality gate did NOT accept / inconclusive-labelled cases

false_abstention_rate.definition: conclusive-labelled cases where the model abstained / conclusive-labelled cases

gate_acceptance_rate.definition: cases accepted by the quality gate / evaluated cases

false_acceptance_rate.definition: accepted cases that are inconclusive-labelled or have the wrong category / accepted cases

relevant_file_hit_rate.definition: cases whose affected_files contain a labelled relevant file / cases with labelled files

unsupported_acceptance_rate.definition: unsupported analyses (inconclusive-labelled or with an unverifiable quote) the gate accepted / unsupported analyses

workflow_failure_rate.definition: cases ending in workflow status 'failed' (e.g. provider errors) / cases
